scenario.name: 01 - Lead Capture: Squarespace → Airtable + Google Sheets
scenario.description: Captures new leads from Squarespace form submissions and creates records in Airtable and Google Sheets simultaneously. Calculates lead score and assigns initial status.

modules.name: Webhooks - Custom Webhook
modules.description: Receives form submission data from Squarespace
modules.notes: After creating this webhook, copy the generated URL and configure it in Squarespace (Settings > Advanced > Webhooks or via form integration).

modules.name: Tools - Set Variable
modules.description: Calculate lead score based on form responses

variables.name: leadScore
variables.formula_explanation: Sum of: Budget points (5-30) + Existing podcast (5-15) + Service type (5-20) + Volume (5-15) + Has website (0-10) + Has phone (0-5) + Referral bonus (0-5). See google-sheets/templates.md for full breakdown.

modules.name: Airtable - Create a Record
modules.description: Create new lead record in Airtable Leads table

modules.name: Google Sheets - Add a Row
modules.description: Add lead data to Google Sheets Lead Tracker for reporting

config.note: Columns N (Lead Score) and O (Lead Grade) are calculated by spreadsheet formulas

modules.name: Router
modules.description: Route based on lead grade for different notification levels

modules.name: Gmail - Send an Email
modules.description: Send internal notification for high-value leads (Grade A) for immediate personal attention

config.subject: 🔥 HIGH-VALUE LEAD: {{1.fullName}} (Score: {{2.leadScore}})

modules.name: Webhooks - Webhook Response
modules.description: Send success response back to Squarespace

errorHandling.description: If any module fails, break the scenario and send an error notification email

setup_instructions: 1. Create a new scenario in Make.com
2. Add 'Webhooks > Custom Webhook' as the trigger module
3. Copy the webhook URL that Make generates
4. Configure Squarespace to send form data to this webhook URL
5. Connect your Airtable account and select the 'Podcast Business CRM' base
6. Connect your Google account for Sheets and Gmail
7. Map all fields as specified in the config above
8. Test with a sample form submission
9. Turn on the scenario and set error notifications
